name: Marathi (Devanagari)
notes: Same script as Hindi, so one Devanagari font stack serves hi, mr and hinglish.
Marathi words run longer than Hindi on average: 30 characters per line, not 34.
No upper case in Devanagari: emphasis comes from weight and colour, never caps.
Technical nouns stay in English (as most Marathi tech channels speak). Never translate a product name.
whisper large-v3 with language=mr; resolve(mr) already sets it.
Starting defaults, not measurements. Measure three videos in your niche before quoting these numbers.
